Filters and range of the data issues to list. The /community/data-library/issues/list API accepts requests in the following format:

ListDataIssuesRequest Model - Request body to list data issues. The filters combine, and a security, market, or resolution value that isn't supported returns an error that lists the valid values.
status string Enum
Status group of the issues to list. Open issues are In queue, In progress, Waiting Review, or Waiting for Data Vendor. Closed issues are Resolved, Closed, or Cannot Be Resolved. The default value is open. Options : ['open', 'closed']
start integer
Index of the first issue to return. The default value is 0.
end integer
example: 20
Index after the last issue to return. The default value is 20.
search string
example: SPY
Words to search for in the issue titles. The search doesn't find words shorter than 3 characters. To filter by ticker, use the ticker property.
ticker string
example: NQ
Ticker to filter the issues by. The ticker must match one of the issue's tickers exactly, but the match isn't case-sensitive.
security string
example: Future
Asset class to filter the issues by, as its name or its short form, such as Future Option or futureoption. The match isn't case-sensitive.
market string
example: CME
Market to filter the issues by, such as CME or Binance. The match isn't case-sensitive.
resolution string
example: Minute
Resolution to filter the issues by, such as Minute or Daily. The match isn't case-sensitive.
subscribed boolean
If true, list only the issues you're subscribed to.
Example 
{
  "status": "open",
  "start": 0,
  "end": 20,
  "search": "SPY",
  "ticker": "NQ",
  "security": "Future",
  "market": "CME",
  "resolution": "Minute",
  "subscribed": true
}
